profile.headline: The time that paranoia, hunger, and stubbornness got together to create an unstoppable problem solver
profile.summary:
I am driven, collaborative, and tenacious. As a software developer I am well rounded and curious, with intuitive problem solving skills and a thirst for self-improvement. I readily work with what I have and know, and I am relentless in obtaining what is needed to solve a problem. I look for an opportunity to collaborate with a team in producing software solutions for complex problems.

My long-term interests lie in software and materials engineering solutions to wearable technology challenges - particularly in the textile industry.

I have overcome many challenges to get to where I am at. My previous and upcoming career moves have been and will be directed at amassing tools and abilities in order to accomplish my end goal.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Maintained code bases, implemented new features, developed new tools
Projects:
• Unit-tested software functionality for an embedded RTOS on a POC device from R&D to production
• Developed a data generation and verification toolset for compressed and encrypted JSON payload
• Ported, debugged, and maintained an existing code-base for a programmable logic line of helium recovery products
• Maintained multiple projects in version control server
• Reported and corrected defects in software
Tools: Linux, Windows, SubVersion, TRAC, Visual Studios, Py-Charm, IAR, CubeMX, QT, Keil, CoDeSys, Visilogic
Languages: Python, JSON, C++, C, C#, Batch, Bash, Pascal, Ladder-logic

positions.title: Collaborator
positions.description:
Lead projects in the field of the Internet of Things using IBM Watson's computing network
Successfully planned and launched two citizen science high altitude balloons equipped with environmental sensors and biological payloads
Projects:
• Set up a raspberry pi network of sensors using IBM Watson’s computing network
• Successfully planned, designed, built, programmed, and launched two high altitude balloons equipped with Arduino-operated environmental sensors and biological payloads
Tools: Raspberry Pi, Arduino, SPOT, NODE-Red, prototype boards, solder station, SolidWorks, 3D Printer

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Directed four sections of mechanics and two sections of electrostatics and magnetism labs in the Physics Department at UC San Diego during my time at the Nanoengineering Department. My typical duties including administering and adapting pre-made lesson plans and quizzes to each section, as well as grading and cataloging student assignments. Each section was composed of approximately 25 students, for 10 weeks of instruction.

positions.title: Costumer
positions.description:
Costumer
August 2015 - December 2015 - Repaired, maintained, and delivered costume garments to entertainment cast members. Styled, maintained, and delivered wigs to LEGO Friends cast members.

Event Assistant
October 2013 - January 2014 - Managed park operations within the theme of the season
Entertained guests with trivia, song, and dance.

Wardrobe Assistant 
June 2013 - September 2013 - Maintained functionality and integrity of wardrobe pieces
Distributed wardrobe to Model Citizens (employees)
Enforced company look, theme, and values across park

positions.title: STEM Ambassador
positions.description: Demonstrated engaging hands-on activities to local students at the Elementary School to High School levels. Imparted scientific principles geared towards boosting underrepresented minority enrollment in higher education in STEM fields. Average audience was composed of 20 students, with most activities lasting 30 minutes.
